title: Near-time-reversal flux to starve the gap guard
hypothesis: Near flux = 0 or 180 degrees, nodes sit close to planes where the gap is below 0.01 t, so the guard discards the Chern jump and the detector misses them.
implementation_plan: Scan flux near 0 and 180 degrees with weyl_detect_like_js and weyl_gap_scan
Keep cases where the two disagree and the referee resolutions agree
Spread cases apart so they are not deduplicated

target_rubrics.description: Finds at least five distinct verified failures (combined_score >= 5)

notes_for_agent: Near-duplicates within 0.03 normalised parameter distance count once.
